## Tone checklist (docs/prd.md section 7)

Tick each one for every piece of user-facing text this PR adds or changes.

- [ ] Describes what happened; never judges food, eating, or the user
- [ ] Gives no diagnosis label and never says what the user "has"
- [ ] Shows no score, ranking, streak, or points
- [ ] Makes no cause-and-effect claim ("X causes Y", "you are sensitive to X")
- [ ] Uses no urgency or guilt
- [ ] Marks state with text or an icon, not color alone

## Safety rules (docs/prd.md section 4)

- [ ] Diet content is still unreachable without a current screen (if this touches `/diet` or screening)
- [ ] Nothing leaves the app without an explicit user action (if this touches export or sharing)
- [ ] No new third-party script, font, or analytics
